dataset_metadata.name: TruthLens Reproducible News Credibility Benchmark Corpus (v1)
dataset_metadata.license: CC0-1.0 (Synthetic journalistic vs sensationalist benchmark; supports drop-in LIAR/FakeNewsNet CSVs)
dataset_metadata.split_strategy: Stratified 80/20 train/test split with vocabulary fit strictly on training fold
limitations: Trained on English news-style linguistic patterns; does not verify real-world factual truth.
Headline-only inputs have limited lexical signal and lower reliability.
Satire, opinion columns, and domain-specific technical writing may trigger false positives.
